abilities.name: Timed Life
abilities.text: Remove this Unit at the End of the Round.

abilities.name: Decoy
abilities.text: This Unit is never Engaged. It cannot Engage Enemy Units, cannot be Engaged by Enemy Units and cannot perform a Charge Action. This Unit cannot be the target of an ability, unless stated otherwise. It can never Control or Contest Mission Markers.

abilities.name: Surprise!
abilities.text: At the End of the Round, you can set a Friendly Nova Stealth Mode or Nova Assault Mode in Coherency with this Unit.

abilities.name: Lethal Hologram
abilities.text: All Weapons of Friendly Units targeting an Enemy Unit Within 4″ of this Unit gain PRECISION (1).
